entries.title: Philippians 4:1
segments: ¶So that, my brethren, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, thus stand fast in [the] Lord, beloved.

entries.title: Philippians 4:2
segments: I exhort Euodia, and exhort Syntyche, to be of the same mind in [the] Lord;

entries.title: Philippians 4:3
segments: yea, I ask thee also, true yokefellow, assist them, who have contended along with me in the glad tidings, with Clement also, and my other fellow-labourers, whose names [are] in [the] book of life.

entries.title: Philippians 4:4
segments: Rejoice in [the] Lord always: again I will say, Rejoice.

entries.title: Philippians 4:5
segments: Let your gentleness be known of all men. The Lord [is] near.

entries.title: Philippians 4:6
segments: Be careful about nothing; but in everything, by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God;

entries.title: Philippians 4:7
segments: and the peace of God, which surpasses every understanding, shall guard your hearts and your thoughts by Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 4:8
segments: For the rest, brethren, whatsoever things [are] true, whatsoever things [are] noble, whatsoever things [are] just, whatsoever things [are] pure, whatsoever things [are] amiable, whatsoever things [are] of good report; if [there be] any virtue and if any praise, think on these things.

entries.title: Philippians 4:9
segments: What ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, these things do; and the God of peace shall be with you.

entries.title: Philippians 4:10
segments: ¶But I rejoiced in [the] Lord greatly, that now however at length ye have revived your thinking of me, though surely ye did also think [of me], but lacked opportunity.

entries.title: Philippians 4:11
segments: Not that I speak as regards privation, for as to me *I* have learnt in those circumstances in which I am, to be satisfied in myself.

entries.title: Philippians 4:12
segments: I know both how to be abased and I know how to abound. In everything and in all things I am initiated both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer privation.

entries.title: Philippians 4:13
segments: I have strength for all things in him that gives me power.

entries.title: Philippians 4:14
segments: But ye have done well in taking part in my affliction.

entries.title: Philippians 4:15
segments: And know also *ye*, O Philippians, that in [the] beginning of the gospel, when I came out of Macedonia, no assembly communicated [anything] to me in [the] way of giving and receiving save *ye* alone;

entries.title: Philippians 4:16
segments: for also in Thessalonica once and even twice ye sent to me for my need.

entries.title: Philippians 4:17
segments: Not that I seek gift, but I seek fruit abounding to your account.

entries.title: Philippians 4:18
segments: But I have all things in full supply and abound; I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things [sent] from you, an odour of sweet savour, an acceptable sacrifice, agreeable to God.

entries.title: Philippians 4:19
segments: But my God shall abundantly supply all your need according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 4:20
segments: ¶But to our God and Father [be] glory to the ages of ages. Amen.

entries.title: Philippians 4:21
segments: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren who [are] with me salute you.

entries.title: Philippians 4:22
segments: All the saints salute you, and specially those of the household of Caesar.

entries.title: Philippians 4:23
segments: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit. Amen.
